# Neon glow

Electric edges and focused light on a deep, quiet canvas.

## Use

Use for launch moments, interactive showcases, and technology campaigns.

## Essential traits

- Luminous cyan borders
- Dark stable reading surfaces
- One accented action

## Typography

System sans-serif with bold headings.

## Layout and surfaces

Dark negative space, concentrated highlights, a single luminous focal point. Cyan edge lighting, dark panels, and tightly controlled glow.

## Palette

- background: #080c19
- surface: #11182a
- text: #f4faff
- muted: #b7c8dc
- accent: #89fbea
- border: #496477

## Copy-ready prompt

```text
Apply Neon glow to [DELIVERABLE] for [AUDIENCE]. Purpose: [GOAL]. Preserve all supplied content, existing visuals, and required brand constraints. System sans-serif with bold headings. Dark negative space, concentrated highlights, a single luminous focal point. Cyan edge lighting, dark panels, and tightly controlled glow. Palette: background #080c19, surface #11182a, text #f4faff, muted #b7c8dc, accent #89fbea, border #496477. Essential traits: Luminous cyan borders; Dark stable reading surfaces; One accented action. Avoid: Glow on body text; Flashing effects; Multiple competing neon colors. Keep motion restrained and optional, respect reduced motion, and provide a static fallback. Adapt the appearance to the requested output format. Keep text legible, controls accessible, and content editable where supported. Resolve mandatory brand conflicts explicitly. Return the design and accurately report performed and unperformed checks.
```

## Validation

Available style specification. Check the actual output; no blanket accessibility or visual-fidelity certification is claimed.
